entities.summary: Aleksandra Waliszewska is an artist from Warsaw, Poland, primarily working as a painter. Her surreal, horrific, highly symbolic, and sometimes gory work has been compared to Hieronymous Bosch and Francisco de Goya, and her style has been called "gothic". Informed by Balto-Slavic folklore such as the upiór, her paintings often depict supernatural figures in urban landscapes.
